phrase.三档。关闭：不处理。轻度：压缩纯语气叠写，不删条。清除（默认）：删: Three levels. Off: no processing. Light: compress pure filler repetitions without deleting cues. Clear (default): remove pure filler cues (うん/はい/嗯/好的, etc.); does not leave gaps by changing the translation to "…". Keeps and translates fillers that help context (e.g. responses, calls, questions between meaningful lines). Keeps dialogue with semantic content. Requires source + translation tracks. Hy-MT has a separate end-of-film ellipsis strategy: pure breaths are removed; meaningful lines must not be replaced with "…".
phrase.全版本可用。主听写完成后、翻译与观影后处理之前，对低置信/幻觉/时: Available in all editions. After primary transcription and before translation and viewing post-processing, locally re-transcribes suspicious windows (low confidence, hallucinations, timing gaps, etc.) and writes back the best result. Prefers re-decoding with the current ASR model (avoids model switching); anime/kotoba still switches to a more stable installed sibling. When off, only writes a confidence sidecar. Auto mode skips when transcription preference is Speed; Always on still runs.
phrase.三档。关闭：不处理。轻度：压缩纯拟声/喘息叠写，不删条。清除（默认: Three levels. Off: no processing. Light: compress pure onomatopoeia/breath repetitions without deleting cues. Clear (default): remove pure onomatopoeia, breaths, light laughs, and katakana SFX cues (はぁ/ふふ/ザァッ/哈啊, etc.); does not leave gaps with "…". Keeps dialogue with semantic content. Requires source + translation tracks. When enabled with Clean filler words, Hy-MT end-of-film ellipsis strategy clears another round of pure breaths and forces filling meaningful blanks.
phrase.Pro。转写规则清洗后、翻译前，用大模型理解语境修正明显听写误听（: Pro. After transcription rule cleanup and before translation, uses a large model to understand context and fix obvious mishearings (not a second full transcription); works for all source types and languages. Auto: suspicious lines only; Enhanced: line-by-line correction for the whole film (slower). Auto mode skips when transcription preference is Speed; Enhanced still runs. Complements ASR second opinion: this fixes source text before translation; second opinion re-listens to low-confidence windows after completion.
phrase.Pro 专属。日语默认：专训模型（Sakura/GalTransl: Pro only. Japanese default: specialized models (Sakura/GalTransl) for line-level translation, then a chat model for story-aware polish (fill missing lines, unify names/先輩, fix obvious mistranslations without inventing plot). When Sentence-level inference model is off, the chat model translates line by line. Requires Pro; choose the sentence-level model under LLM inference translation model.
phrase.下载模型超时时请用国内镜像；可留空或点「官方」直连。镜像与代理可同: If model downloads time out, use a domestic mirror; leave blank or click Official for a direct connection. Mirror and proxy can be used together: mirror changes the download source, proxy changes the outbound path. Gated models (e.g. Cohere Transcribe) require accepting terms on the official site and entering a Token below; use the Official endpoint for gated downloads.
phrase.默认开启。仅对时长 ≥2.8s 且读速过快的长句智能拆分（短促快语: On by default. Intelligently splits long cues ≥2.8s with excessive reading speed (keeps ASR timing for short, fast speech). Batch post-processing does not move subtitle start times earlier. Continuous text without spaces may not split automatically; if timing is still off, disable this or switch to TEN/FireRed timing presets.
phrase.用于 Pro「智能翻译」的影片简要（混合开启时句级另走推理模型；关: Film brief used by Pro Smart Translate (when hybrid is on, sentence level uses the inference model; when off, the chat model translates line by line). Choose a general chat model (e.g. Qwen Instruct); do not choose translation-only models like Sakura (those are for inference translation).
phrase.三档。关闭：不处理。轻度：句号、顿号/逗号、破折号与装饰省略号改为: Three levels. Off: no processing. Light: periods, enumeration/commas, dashes, and decorative ellipses become spaces (multiple spaces collapsed to one); question and exclamation marks kept. Clear (default): on top of Light, exclamation marks also become spaces; only question marks kept. Runs after CPS splitting and repetition compression.
phrase.按所选频率在后台检查 GitHub / GitCode 发布页。下: Checks GitHub / GitCode release pages in the background at the selected frequency. When downloading updates on domestic networks, GitCode is preferred, with speed tests and automatic fallback to other mirrors. Prompts to upgrade when a new version is found; does not auto-download or install. Click Save Settings for changes to take effect.
phrase.主界面「参数」选智能感知后强制按感知方案运行；点击文件名旁魔术棒可: When Smart Sense is selected under Parameters on the main window, runs strictly by the sensed profile; click the wand beside the filename to toggle adopt/do not adopt. Do-not-adopt preferences are remembered by folder and series ID; same folder/series will not auto-adopt next time. Clearing does not affect existing sense results in the current list.
phrase.默认关闭。仅在智能感知开启时生效。开启后，拖入/添加的文件会直接跑: Off by default. Only applies when Smart Sense is on. When on, dropped/added files run deep sensing directly (short-window language, acoustic analysis, etc.)—more accurate but slower; when off, still uses quick sense—if the quick result is Unrecognized, deep sensing runs once automatically.
phrase.自动：本机有 Transub.Editor.exe 则用外部，否则: Auto: use external if Transub.Editor.exe is present locally, otherwise built-in. Falls back to built-in if external is not found or fails to start. Built-in Electron editor is marked for deprecation; some Pro actions still force the built-in window.
phrase.仅 Qwen3-ASR TEN/FireRed 人声帧路径。自动：: Qwen3-ASR TEN/FireRed vocal-frame path only. Auto: dynamic batch inference by free VRAM; Conservative: no more than the previous 8/16 segments; Aggressive: up to 16/32 segments when VRAM allows. OOM automatically splits batches.
phrase.仅在任务进行中，于进度条下方显示整机 CPU、内存占用；若检测到: During tasks only, shows system-wide CPU and memory usage below the progress bar; if an NVIDIA driver is detected, also shows GPU utilization and VRAM. Refreshes about every 5 seconds; no sampling outside tasks. When this switch is off, never shown.
phrase.决定哪里算「有人说话」。VAD 模型在「模型」页选择。Whispe: Determines what counts as someone speaking. Choose the VAD model on the Models page. Whisper uses threshold/duration parameters; SenseVoice is mainly affected by Max segment duration. Scene presets and Smart Sense may also override these.
phrase.勾选后每个引擎任务结束都卸载模型。未勾选时：Sakura/智能翻译: When checked, unloads models after every engine task. When unchecked: Sakura/Smart Translate still release by default to hand off to the LLM; multi-file Qwen batches automatically keep VRAM between items and release after the whole batch. Other models unchanged.
phrase.影片理解重构生成 Film Brief 时如何读取字幕。自适应：按: How subtitles are read when Film Understanding Reconstruct generates a Film Brief. Adaptive: samples by film length (local models up to ~56 lines to save VRAM). Full text: sends all subtitles—richer characters/plot, but slower and heavier on context and VRAM.
phrase.进 ASR 前用 ffmpeg 轻度降噪（高通 + 轻频谱降噪）。: Light ffmpeg denoise before ASR (high-pass + mild spectral denoise). Slightly slower; good for material with ambient noise. For BGM removal use Pro → Film audio enhancement. Scene presets may also override this.
phrase.日语智能翻译默认：每一句交给 Sakura / GalTransl: Japanese Smart Translate default: each line goes to Sakura / GalTransl (same class of specialized models as inference translation). When off, the whole segment is translated line by line by the Smart Translate model. Auto-fallback if inference models are not downloaded or source is not Japanese.
phrase.同时处理多个字幕批次，可缩短 推理翻译总耗时。自动模式会按模型体积: Process multiple subtitle batches in parallel to shorten total inference translation time. Auto mode decides parallelism by model size and available VRAM (forced single batch right after ASR). Changes take effect on next llama-server start.
phrase.软件内模型可下载用于本地推理；智能翻译、BYOK、更大模型、语境/: In-app models can be downloaded for local inference; Smart Translate, BYOK, larger models, context/film reconstruct, and film audio enhancement require Pro. License fee does not include cloud API quota. Canceling the settings window does not roll back changes here.
phrase.可尝试「Anime Whisper」——软声 / 动画 / Gal: Try Anime Whisper—more stable for soft-voice / anime / Galgame Japanese transcription. Using it disables Smart Sense and writes all preset parameters (you can also choose it later from the Recognition menu).
phrase.批量生成结束后，向每条成功任务的译文字幕插入所选预设组（片名/演员: After batch generation, inserts the selected preset group (title/actors, etc.) into each successful task's translated subtitles. Timing: absolute anchors from video start; relative playback positions in batch also from video start. Manage in Subtitle Editor → Preset groups.
phrase.拖入几部你常做的片子（可选，最多 5 部）。会做深度语种与类型检测: Drop a few films you often work on (optional, up to 5). Runs deep language and genre detection (skips opening short window, does not trust container mislabeled English) to pick transcription and translation. Skippable; next step checks runtime libraries for recommended transcription.
phrase.内置 Electron 编辑器即将停用。请改用独立 Transub: Built-in Electron editor is being deprecated. Switch to standalone Transub Editor (Settings → Subtitle editor → Open with: Auto/External). Some Pro actions still use this window.
phrase.4K 等超高分辨率且系统缩放偏低时，界面文字容易偏小。「自动」会在: On 4K and other very high resolutions with low system scaling, UI text can look small. Auto moderately enlarges on such displays; no extra scaling when system scaling is already ≥150%. Can also manually fix at 100%–150%.
phrase.检测出问题后自动写回：一键修复走规则；智能修复为 Pro。Pro: After detecting issues, auto-write-back: One-click fix uses rules; Smart fix is Pro. Pro defaults to Smart fix. When transcription preference is Speed, Smart fix becomes One-click fix (avoids extra local re-transcription) for faster completion.
phrase.将全局术语表中「别名 → 标准译名」传给引擎，在 Opus 翻译时: Passes global glossary alias → standard translation to the engine to protect proper nouns during Opus translation. Fill corresponding Chinese standard names for source-language aliases in the glossary. Does not apply to Sakura / Smart Translate.
phrase.默认开启。删除空句、语气碎片、音效标签、纯符号及常见幻觉短句（如「: On by default. Removes empty lines, filler fragments, SFX tags, pure symbols, and common hallucination short lines (e.g. 完毕). When source + translation tracks match in count, deletes in pairs to stay aligned; no longer blanks translation to "…".
phrase.llama.cpp v0.3 推测解码：主模型推理时用小模型草稿加: llama.cpp v0.3 speculative decoding: uses a small draft model to speed up main model inference. Requires the corresponding small model installed (e.g. Qwen2.5 7B → 1.5B). Auto-fallback if startup fails.
phrase.在「翻译」「双语」任务中生效。任务完成后的最后一步才做简繁转换（在: Applies to Translate and Bilingual tasks. Simplified/traditional conversion runs as the final step after cleanup/repetition/CPS/QC. Traditional defaults to Taiwan wording (e.g. 软件→軟體); can also choose character form only or Hong Kong.
phrase.本地 LLM 推理翻译（如 Sakura 等）。在「常规」选「推理: Local LLM inference translation (e.g. Sakura). Used when General selects Inference translation. Leave blank for auto-match (by source language, Pro, and hardware). Lists downloaded items only.
phrase.片头/片尾各 2 秒。译文中文、原文英文（保持条数对齐）；双语文件: 2 seconds at opening/closing. Translation in Chinese, source in English (line count aligned); bilingual file has CN/EN two lines. If subtitles exist in the slot, appends on a new line to the first line. On by default in free tier; auto-off after Pro unlock.
phrase.扫描重叠、读速、时长、叠词与通顺度嫌疑；点击上方标签可按问题类型筛: Scans overlaps, reading speed, duration, repetitions, and fluency suspects; click tags above to filter by issue type. One-click fix can adjust timing/split/compress repetitions/clean noise; truncated endings etc. need re-transcription or manual edit.
phrase.本版已内置独立版引擎（软件目录下的 transub-engine）: This edition bundles the standalone engine (transub-engine under the app folder). Usually no change needed; for custom setup, point to the Transub Engine folder.
phrase.在专训句级译文上，用对话模型补欠译、统一人名/先輩、纠正明显错译，: On specialized line-level translations, uses a chat model to fill missing lines, unify names/先輩, fix obvious mistranslations, and smooth machine-like wording. Does not invent plot. Requires Smart Translate model configured; auto-skips without a chat model.
phrase.二意见采纳窗自动追加 JSONL 到用户数据目录 tmp/asr-: Second-opinion adoption window auto-appends JSONL to user data tmp/asr-bad-pool/ for confirmed domain correction rules. Not uploaded; not in public git.
phrase.将连续重复 ≥3 次的短语/单字压成两次叠写（如「好的」×8 →「: Compresses phrases/characters repeated ≥3 times to double repetition (e.g. 好的×8 → 好的好的!), lowering CPS. Does not change timing; no longer inserts ellipses—please verify by ear.
phrase.软件界面显示语言。与「中文字幕类型」无关；字幕简繁请在任务或目标语: App UI display language. Unrelated to Chinese subtitle type; set subtitle simplified/traditional in tasks or target language separately. Extracted UI strings convert immediately on switch; unextracted areas temporarily fall back to Simplified Chinese.
phrase.从起始点向后截取指定时长，调用本地引擎重转写，并替换该时间窗内重叠: From the start point, captures the specified duration, re-transcribes with the local engine, and replaces overlapping subtitles in that window. Speed-up option: enable Re-transcribe acceleration in Settings → Subtitle editor.
phrase.经典布局左侧占比（约 28–62）。编辑器内可用「布局」按钮切换经: Classic layout left panel ratio (~28–62). In the editor, use Layout to switch Classic / Immersive / Focus / Full-width timeline, or drag panel title bars to combine freely.
phrase.用于语境重构、影片理解重构、语义审阅等。请选用通用对话模型（如 Q: For context reconstruct, film understanding reconstruct, semantic review, etc. Choose a general chat model (e.g. Qwen Instruct), not translation-only models like Sakura.
phrase.结合局部上下文做本地单遍推理翻译，质量中上、更快；适合日语片源（如: Local single-pass inference translation with local context—good quality, faster; suited to Japanese sources (e.g. Sakura); download corresponding GGUF on Models page. Free tier available.
phrase.批量删除 ASR 常见杂音条目：空文本、语气碎片、音效标签、纯符号: Batch-delete common ASR noise entries: empty text, filler fragments, SFX tags, pure symbols, optional consecutive repeats, and optional hallucination short lines. Does not modify text of kept entries.
phrase.一组可包含多条按时段排列的文案（如片名 0–0.5s、演员 0.6: A group can contain multiple timed texts (e.g. title 0–0.5s, actors 0.6–1.5s). On insert, batch-creates subtitles by playback position or video start.
phrase.编辑器保存时是否把原文件复制为 .bak。默认不生成；选「字幕目录: Whether the editor copies the original to .bak on save. Off by default; Subtitle folder writes alongside subtitles; App data folder writes under program data backup.
phrase.影响机器翻译、推理翻译与智能翻译的默认文风。与「运行环境 → 忠实: Affects default tone for machine translation, inference translation, and Smart Translate. Independent from Runtime → Faithful tone: style controls register; faithful controls sanitization. Task list can override per item.
phrase.由 Transub Engine 内置机器翻译（如 Opus）完成: Done by Transub Engine built-in machine translation (e.g. Opus)—average quality; manage models on Models page; leave blank for auto by source language.
phrase.默认开启。将连续重复 ≥3 次的短语/单字压成两次叠写（如「好的」: On by default. Compresses phrases/characters repeated ≥3 times to double repetition (e.g. 好的×8 → 好的好的!), no longer inserts ellipses, lowering CPS.
phrase.句号、顿号/逗号、破折号与装饰省略号（…）改为空格（多空格收成一个: Periods, enumeration/commas, dashes, and decorative ellipses (…) become spaces (multiple spaces collapsed); question and exclamation marks kept (duplicates collapsed to one). Does not change timing.
phrase.llama-server 后端与安装请到「运行环境」页管理。此处仅: Manage llama-server backend and installation on Runtime page. Here only choose Smart Translate / LLM inference models and download GGUF.
phrase.「资源空闲」指 GPU 利用率、显存与内存占用均处于低水平（约每: Resources idle means GPU utilization, VRAM, and memory are all low (~every 15 seconds; memory only without NVIDIA GPU).
phrase.对润色改过的条目再跑一轮：明显跑题/净化则回退专训草稿，其余由对话: Runs another pass on polished entries: obvious off-topic/sanitized lines revert to specialized draft; others judged accept/revert by chat model. Failure does not block.
phrase.与主界面「参数」菜单中的「智能感知」配合。未选智能感知时，下列选项: Works with Smart Sense in main window Parameters menu. Options below inactive unless Smart Sense is selected. Scene presets and VAD fine params on Recognition params page.
phrase.专供 Pro「智能翻译 / 语境重构」的聊天大模型，与上方「模型」: Chat LLM for Pro Smart Translate / context reconstruct only; unrelated to engine ASR·MT·inference translation on Models page above. Changes on this page
phrase.按样片/默认听写推荐，检查 SenseVoice 或 Whispe: Checks SenseVoice or Whisper runtime and related models per sample/default transcription recommendation. One-click fix for anything missing.
phrase.提高 VAD 阈值（约 0.6）、略缩短单段上限，宁可漏掉极轻低语: Raises VAD threshold (~0.6), slightly shortens max segment length—prefer missing very soft whispers for cleaner segments. Stacks with fine params below.
phrase.一键/智能 QC 修复时：字数（不计空白）超过此值则尝试按视频静音: During one-click/smart QC fix: if character count (excluding spaces) exceeds this, try split by video silence. Requires linked video. Default 15; 0 to disable.
phrase.保存设置后代理立即对主进程联网生效；若引擎已在运行，请到「运行环境: After saving settings, proxy applies immediately to main process networking; if engine is running, re-detect on Runtime page to apply proxy and mirror to the engine process.
phrase.下次启动软件时打开的界面。命令行指定字幕文件或 --editor-: Screen opened on next app launch. CLI subtitle file or --editor-only still takes priority. Restart required after change.
phrase.引擎内置 Opus 等机器翻译。在「常规」选「机器翻译」时使用；可: Engine built-in Opus etc. machine translation. Used when General selects Machine translation; leave blank for auto by source language. Downloaded items only.
phrase.引擎整体速度/质量权衡（与「识别参数」场景预设无关）。速度更快、质: Engine-wide speed/quality tradeoff (unrelated to Recognition params scene presets). Speed faster, Quality more accurate, Balanced in between. Used for model recommendations and download tiers.
phrase.按语音边界过滤/切段后再识别。关闭后整段送入 ASR，可能更慢、更: Filter/split by speech boundaries before recognition. Off sends whole segment to ASR—may be slower and noisier; try off if soft speech is still heavily lost.
phrase.智能断句与静音分割会在标点/空白之外，优先在这些词之后切开字幕。支: Smart sentence split and silence split cut subtitles after these words in addition to punctuation/spaces. Supports Chinese and English; add multiple at once with commas or newlines.
phrase.主窗口、字幕编辑器与窗口标题栏的浅色 / 深色外观。与主界面「更多: Light / dark appearance for main window, subtitle editor, and window title bar. Synced with main More → Dark UI and editor theme toggle.
phrase.勾选后，添加媒体、打开字幕等文件对话框会回到上次选用文件所在的文件: When checked, Add media, Open subtitle, etc. dialogs reopen in the last folder used. Unchecked uses system default start location.
phrase.连续高读速 / 粘连区间，以及 ASR 低置信时间窗的局部重转写（: Local re-transcription for consecutive high CPS / stuck ranges and ASR low-confidence windows (requires linked video; consecutive windows in same quota prioritized).
phrase.先生成全片 Brief（人物/专名/语气），确认后再按场景改写。可: Generate full-film Brief (characters/proper names/tone) first, confirm, then rewrite by scene. Optional title and synopsis; can start with blanks.
phrase.浏览、搜索并下载 ASR / VAD / MT / 推理翻译与人声: Browse, search, and download ASR / VAD / MT / inference translation and vocal separation models. Selection set above on this page.
phrase.按标点与断句词拆分符合条件的字幕，并按目标读速分配各段时间。可在「: Split eligible subtitles by punctuation and break words, allocating time by target reading speed. Manage word list in Tools → Break words.
phrase.编辑器内按字数调时长、分割时间分配的参考读速。与「任务处理」里批量: Reference reading speed in editor for duration-by-char-count and split time allocation. Independent from batch CPS split default in Task processing.
phrase.无论任务是转录、翻译还是双语，都额外保留「转录部分」字幕，方便二次: Whether task is transcribe, translate, or bilingual, also keeps transcription track for re-translation and semantic features needing source text.
phrase.整片译完后按风险分抽样送入对话模型润色。越大越贴合但更慢、更费额度: After full-film translation, samples by risk score into chat model polish. Higher = better fit but slower and more quota. Range 4–36, default 36.
phrase.基于 OpenCC（opencc-js，含分词与地区词典），不改时: Based on OpenCC (opencc-js, with segmentation and regional dictionaries); does not change timing. Protect proper names with glossary.
phrase.实验项：Pro 智能翻译 / 多轮 LLM 启用并行槽。更占显存，: Experimental: enable parallel slots for Pro Smart Translate / multi-turn LLM. Uses more VRAM; recommend off on 8GB GPUs.
phrase.下载后可在上方「当前选用」中指定；已下载模型可点「删除」释放空间，: After download, assign in Current selection above; Delete downloaded models to free space; Manual download when network is poor.
phrase.引擎下载模型时使用的 Hugging Face Hub 地址。默认: Hugging Face Hub address used when the engine downloads models. Domestic mirror by default; blank for official direct.
phrase.打开选中字幕做时间轴精修。算力经本机工厂 Factory RPC；: Open selected subtitles for timing refinement. Compute via local Factory RPC; Pro and Factory share license.
phrase.确定清空全部自动感知纠错记忆（目录 / 系列偏好）？ 当前列表里已: Clear all auto-sense correction memory (folder / series preferences)? Existing sense results in the current list will not be cleared.
phrase.导出当前已保存设置为 JSON，或从备份文件载入到表单（载入后仍需: Export current saved settings as JSON, or load from backup into the form (still click Save Settings at bottom after load).
phrase.对推理翻译 / 智能翻译生效；机器翻译（Opus）不受风格影响。确: Applies to inference translation / Smart Translate; machine translation (Opus) ignores style. Syncs to selected tasks on confirm.
phrase.请先核对人物、专名与梗概；确认后才会开始场景改写。Brief 不准: Review characters, proper names, and synopsis first; scene rewrite starts after confirm. If Brief is wrong, the whole film drifts.
phrase.双语任务完成后合并为一份文件，默认与影片同名（便于播放器自动挂载）: After bilingual task, merge into one file, default same name as video (for player auto-mount). Bilingual tasks only.
phrase.主界面「参数」选智能感知且已采纳时，强制用感知匹配的语种与模型；下: When main Parameters selects Smart Sense and adopted, forces sensed language and model; global selection below does not apply.
phrase.润色后统一人名/敬称：先本地去掉「标准名小姐」类噪声，必要时再抽样: After polish, unify names/honorifics: locally strip noise like 标准名小姐, sample chat model if needed. On by default.
phrase.默认优先 CUDA；无可用 GPU 或显存不足时请选 CPU。「自: CUDA preferred by default; choose CPU if no GPU or insufficient VRAM. Auto lets the engine decide.
